name: linux_arm
title: Linux ARM
description: Linux ARM is a Unix-like and mostly POSIX-compliant computer operating system (OS) assembled under the model of free and open-source software development and distribution. Using host OS (Mac OS X, Linux ARM) you can build native application for Linux ARM platform.

libgpiod.description: libgpiod is the official Linux kernel GPIO library using the character device interface (/dev/gpiochip*). Works across all Linux ARM SBCs (Raspberry Pi, Orange Pi, Rock Pi, etc.) with kernel-enforced GPIO exclusivity
libgpiod.title: libgpiod

lgpio.description: lgpio is a modern C library for Linux GPIO access, supporting all Raspberry Pi models including Pi 5 with the RP1 I/O controller
lgpio.title: lgpio

wiringpi.description: WiringPi is a GPIO access library written in C for the BCM2835+ used in the Raspberry Pi. Now maintained by GC2 (Grazer Computer Club) with Raspberry Pi 5 support (GCLK function not supported on Pi 5)
wiringpi.title: WiringPi (GC2 Fork)

pigpio.description: pigpio is a feature-rich C library for Raspberry Pi GPIO control with microsecond timing, PWM, and servo support (Pi 1-4, not Pi 5 compatible)
pigpio.title: pigpio

upload_run_after.description: Execute uploaded program immediately after successful upload

upload_run_command.description: Custom command to run the uploaded program (overrides default execution)

upload_run_timeout.description: Timeout for remote program execution in seconds (default: 60)

upload_user.description: Default SSH username for uploads (default: pi)

upload_ssh_key.description: Path to SSH private key for authentication

test_transport.description: Test upload transport: ssh or manual (default: ssh)
